home.title: ghiberti85/ui
home.subtitle: Design systems & component library by Fernando Ghiberti
home.description: A collection of design systems and React components built for authorial projects. Multiple visual identities, one component API.
home.ds_minimal_desc: Clean, functional, system-neutral. Built for products.

home.how_tokens_desc: Three visual identities defined as W3C design tokens

home.how_themes_desc: Switch themes at runtime — one data-theme attribute

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.subtitle: Install the packages, configure your theme, and render your first component in minutes.
gettingStarted.step_install_desc: Add both the tokens and the UI component library to your project.
gettingStarted.step_tokens_desc: Import one design system stylesheet at the root of your app (e.g. layout.tsx or _app.tsx). This injects all CSS custom properties into the page.
gettingStarted.step_tokens_tip: Each design system ships its own CSS file. You can load multiple systems and switch between them at runtime using the data-theme attribute.
gettingStarted.step_theme_title: Apply a theme to your HTML element
gettingStarted.step_theme_desc: Add data-theme to your <html> tag. All components read tokens from that scope automatically.
gettingStarted.step_component_desc: Import any component from @ghiberti85/ui and drop it into your JSX. No extra configuration needed.
gettingStarted.step_switch_desc: Themes and dark mode are pure CSS — flip a data attribute at runtime and every component updates instantly.

playground.title: Theme Playground
playground.description: Customize design tokens in real time
playground.how_desc: Adjust the sliders and color pickers on the left to override CSS custom properties in real time. The preview panel reflects every change instantly — no build step required. Copy the resulting CSS snippet and paste it into your project's global stylesheet.
